package nest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"testing"
)

func TestReviewFailedBuildModifiesAlreadyRegisteredDAO(t *testing.T) {
	manager := entity.NewEntityManager()
	pilot := addPilots(t, manager, 39500, 1)[0]
	existing := manager.Get(pilot).(*rollbackTestEntity)
	id := mustBuildCastID(t, 39501, 1, failedCreateKind)
	planFailedCreate(t, id, failedCreatePlan{stage: failedCreateInBuilder, sideEffect: func() error { return writeFailedCreateDAO(existing.dao, 77) }})
	committer := &recordingCommitter{}
	mgr := NewEngine(NestOptionWithGetter(entity.NewManagerAccess(manager)), NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(committer))
	name := NewHandlerName("review_existing_dao_during_failed_create")
	mgr.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, []any, ...HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		if err := writeFailedCreateDAO(existing.dao, 5); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		_, err := manager.Create(failedCreateParam(id))
		if !errors.Is(err, errFailedCreateRejected) {
			return nil, errors.New("fixture: expected initialization rejection")
		}
		return "handled", nil
	}, HandlerMeta{Rollback: RollbackState, Durability: DurabilityStrict})
	if err := mgr.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer mgr.Shutdown(context.Background())
	_, err := mgr.Request(context.Background(), name, pilot, nil)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrFailedCreateLeftEffects) {
		t.Fatalf("failed build's external write escaped guard: err=%v value=%d mutations=%+v", err, existing.dao.Value, committer.record.Mutations)
	}
	if existing.dao.Value != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("rollback value=%d", existing.dao.Value)
	}
}
